name: Syong Shun Metal Co. Ltd.
summary: Syong Shun Metal Co. Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise engaged in the manufacturing and sale of steel products. The company primarily furnishes wire rods, which are essential components for producing a diverse array of items, including fasteners like screws and nuts, various types of steel wire and cables, hand tools, automotive parts, and general mechanical components. Established in 2010, its operations are based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
